scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npx prisma@5.22.0 generate
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: if [ -z "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then echo 'ERROR: DATABASE_URL is missing. Please link your Postgres service in Railway variables.'; exit 1; fi && npx prisma@5.22.0 db push --accept-data-loss --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && cd backend && npm start
